clips.title: Worldcup26: Brit tries texas twinkies
clips.transcript: Today we're in Dallas trying the famous Texas Twinkie. This is Hutchins Barbecue and out the back They have a Texas Twinkie factory. The Twinkie makers make over half a million of these things a year It starts off with a 17 -hour slow -smoke brisket Which is diced chopped up and then stuffed into a cream cheese Jalapeno and then wrapped in bacon before being smoked off for three hours Grilled over fire and then brushed off with a sweet and sticky glaze Cheers Wow The creaminess of the cheese against the fattiness of the brisket The fruitiness of the jalapeno and then it's just held in by that smoky bacon Which is like a hug from your grandma and don't even get me started on that sweet and sticky rib glaze for seven dollars You don't beat this NASA flew the first astronaut to space these guys Invented the first ever Texas Twinkie. I'm not sure who's the bigger legend
